topics.text: You walk on root-bridges like a dry-lander. Speak, and speak plainly, and the Hist may forgive your noise.
The sap is not drink and it is not medicine. It is memory. Drink it and you remember what the tree remembers, which is mostly drowning.
Xul-Ha keeps its own laws. Blackwood men call us a little kingdom and laugh; they laugh less after the wet season.
Go north past the stilt-granary until the water tastes of iron. The Weeping Root is there and it does not like company.
Mercenaries out of Blackwood. They pay in Septims and lies. I took both, once.
Nobody speaks of the drowned hall. Nobody who came back, anyway.
